items.description: Let Timeline be filled with words from the heart. Moment is a service which enables you and your friends to send best wishes to your loved ones at their precious moment with Twitter. You can fill out Timeline for a baby shower to celebrate the birth of new life, to boost up a friend who starts on a journey, or as a bouquet to celebrate oneâ€™s birthday.
PhoneTacToe uses the Twilio, Twilio SMS and Heroku APIs and allows you to play a quick game of tic-tac-toe with a friend on your phone.
CallRail makes it easy to track which marketing sources make your phone ring. You can track phone numbers instantly and get reports in realtime.
KnowledgeTreeLive is a hosted, on-demand edition of the KnowledgeTree Document Management Software to manage documents, secure documents, and collaborate.
Listmania cc is a collection of book lists and film lists. Listmania cc will improve the experience of browsing and reviewing all these lists.
Ringostrack.com is a website to find and listen online to soundtracks. Amazon integration provides details.
Kapital Moto TV is a niche video website for quality motorcycle content. Choose a map location and watch content filmed there. This works especially well in a close Satellite view.
A map mashup of World Cup Soccer 2010 Venues along with a StreetView look at the venues.
Provides small businesses an interface to enter polling questions, possible answers and tabulates the responses to provide valuable information to the merchant. Formerly called Voicify.
Very good, up-to-date gas price search with Google Maps station display.

CyclistNexus is an online cycling community, offering cyclists the opportunity to find, map and share routes, connect with local cyclists, find and form new riding groups, and manage cycling related activities.
Finda Park was started as a fun app just to allow people to find parks in the Seattle area using their zip code. This app uses open data from data.seattle.gov.
Search and find YouTube videos, watch a video, and share it with friends.
Site showing images and text from 100 worldwide travel locations. From Antarctica to Zanzibar- travel destinations around the world.
Lists the most popular bookmarks in del.icio.us over specific time periods, such as 4 hours, a day, a week, a month and a year.
New York Subway and Bus Maps with point to point directions. Useful and well designed.
Use this interactive Flash-based app to browse EA's Spore creatures to decide how will you browse the Universe.

If you ever had problems ordering camera supplies from a vendor in NYC, then this map might be of interest. It plots the locations, along with photos and comments, of dozens of vendors. Not always reputable ones.
Slick custom interface on Virtual Earth map to search for real estate in Australia with user-defined property criteria and location.
Pingram allows users to search through Instagram photos using a Pinterest like interface.
A fun way to explore Flickr images based on your own taste. Select a couple of images you like and instantly get recommendations, based on like-minded people.
Real estate listings of land for sale in Texas using Google Maps.

Pediax allows browsing of 50,000 geo-referenced Wikipedia articles on Google Maps. It shows the 20 most popular places in the currently selected map area. On moves or zooming of the map area the respective places are updated.
MusicNectar is a mashup of lastfm, and youtube. The aim of MusicNectar is to make listening to youtube music videos easier, and more informative.
Lagunagram pulls photos from Instagram and displays posts from in and around downtown Laguna Beach in real-time.
The PickRent Mapping Widget shows rental listings from you, the property manager in an interactive way. Just customize the widget to your liking and then embed code in your own site or blog.

DFW Restaurant Week(s) is from 8/12 - 9/2/2013. Instead of a sad static list of restaurants that's not even sortable, we took the list of participating venues, put them on a map, and added a bunch of other cool features to find directions, what's nearby, ratings, etc. I have plenty more cool features in mind, more APIs to add, & hope to do it again next year! Works on mobile devices too!
Find out estimated carbon emissions and fuel costs based on the driving directions you provide. Enter your daily commute or any other trip. View various ideas about how to reduce your emissions.
Handoff is a web/phone conferencing demo. It allows users to create rooms via the web or their phone and enter a room with the correct room and pin number.
This site is a demo to show the functionality of the Shopping.com API version 3. Includes all local US,UK,DE,FR,AU.

Android app allows one to write a short message (such as a historical sign's text) and assign it to a gps location. When a user enters the area, the text is spoken on their phone. Includes over 111,000 points covering roadside markers , historical bridges, even ufo sighting locations and have added them to the data base. It includes states such as Texas, Virginia, Georgia, Oregon, Michigan, and Pennsylvania's entire historical roadside marker collections plus a ton of other points to hear all over the country and even in Canada.
A mashup that produces output showing the @reply tweets you're no longer seeing in your Twitter stream (since #fixreplies) because you don't follow the person the message is directed to.
Watch and listen to Punk, Rock'n'Roll, Psychobilly, Rockabilly, Grunge and other rock music genres compiled from submissions to rock music subreddits.
An online flirtation site that lets you anonymously send pre-defined sms messages to people you know and check the read status.
Breakfasts, lunches and dinners from Twitter.
Kinoma Play is a social media browser for smartphones, and this mashup allows Box.net users to access their accounts from within Kinoma.

MTBGuru.com is designed for bikers, hikers and runners to publish, share and visualize GPS data, along with photos and commentary, creating an ever-expanding free trail resource and community of GPS users.

A simple Google maps mashup calculating sailing distances in nautical miles. The map may be shared with friends through social media or email. Designed for the Greek islands but may be used for anywhere in the world.
Google Maps Mashup of US Towns and Cities named with Christmas or Holiday Season Names

This hack was created at [MoDevEast in Washington DC](http://blog.mashery.com/content/awesome-dc-hackathon-usa-today-hq-modeveast). It was designed to be a proof of concept of how you can use the fact that Siri can send emails along with [SendGrid's Parse API](http://docs.sendgrid.com/documentation/api/parse-api-2/) to create your own custom Siri API. When you are done with this tutorial, you will be able to ask Siri to motivate you and Siri will oblidge by calling you via Twilio to tell you You are Awesome. :) I hope that you take this concept to the next level and dream up interesting things for Siri to do. At the [SendGrid Mobile Hackday](http://sendgridmh.eventbrite.com/) a few developers asked Siri to check them into Foursquare, post to Twitter and remotely launch apps on their Macs.

GoogleBrazil.net is a site dedicated to find the best, most dense and useful information about Brazil. Interactive Maps point to resourceful information about Brazil. Click on a spot to get detailled information.
Hamkry is an online booking company that provides customers access to travel-related information such as booking flights, buses, hotels, and car rentals.
Mobile Commons provides many ways for citizens to contact their local representatives in the Senate and Congress, as well as the President of the United States.
Alternative interface to Amazon. Primarily via Amazon AWS, also incorporates del.icio.us, GMail, DropCash, Blogger and a library lookup.
View the lines and stops of the metro system in Naples, Italy.
Find ethnic restaurants in your neighborhood.

The Google SEO checker helps you to find out how Google scores your on-page SEO efforts. Based on 14 key features Google will give you feedback and recommendations to improve your website for search. Some examples of the elements that are included when performing the analysis are indexation, status code, robots.txt, canonical, meta description, title tag and more..

Hotel mashups of Google Map, more then 30.000 hotels to locate on the map. View hotels on the map with Panoramic street view of the location where available. APIs used Hotel Club, Google Maps and Street Cities.
Users can Dub any YouTube video with the sound of the other video, classify them as funny, sad, action etc. View user videos and then share their creations with friends. More uses onsite.
Quickly find campus buildings with this campus map of the University of Texas at Austin.
MapSkip allows you to share stories and photos about the places that are important in your life.
Google Maps Mashup of vacation and travel information in Germany.

BanksNearMe is built with Google Maps API and the Google Places API and can be integrated with Bootstrap's mobile-first framework to help you find nearby banks and ATMs based on your current location, or by custom search. BanksNearMe is a free service.
Price comparison and shopping portal website.
Using hotel information from AsiaTravel.com with Google Maps respectively users can sort, view and book Singapore hotels.

This map shows all UK trains currently on approach to a particular station. Data is fetched from the National Rail website. The yellow pins are stations, the red pins trains. The trains move in approximately real time.

The feedly app aggregates a user's favorite sites into a streamlined summary. Feedly uses RSS feeds to display cards pertaining to a user's curated tastes. Feedly for iOS is compatible with iPhone and iPad, with syncing available for use on multiple devices. Feedly's social functions make sharing content to major social hubs very easy. Feedly also syncs with Pocket, Instapaper, and Evernote to allow personal information management across apps.

In this game the player will test his memory and the use of his network. There will be a ranking for each month, and the most important thing, with this experiment we will learn what are the most common features from the most recognized avatars on twitter. Let's play!

CampusBird is the first interactive 3D and Maps-based school search site. Search for schools by name, location, scene, weather, school size, and more. CampusBird provides in depth profiles of more than 4800 schools and hundreds in 3D. Formerly called Egiate.
MyMemory Language Translator is an application that lets users to translate text from one language to another. This application uses the MyMemory API service.
An interactive map that displays news for the specific country you click on. A Google Maps, Google News, and Geonames.org mashup.
Watch the internet as it's being uploaded. Every 10 seconds it grabs the newest public photo from Flickr.
Free online search tool that takes advantage of Google geocoding service and third party Web Map Service with postcode and suburb boundary outlines.
GeoGuessr is an exciting way to explore the world using Google Maps to guess what area you are looking at. Take a look at the picture and make your best guess, it is harder than it looks.
Real time Google maps of current parking availability in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Voicendo provides a user interface for small businesses and independent professionals to manage their incoming phone calls (even SMS) routed according to their call rules, routes and variables, anywhere and however they like. Supports toll-free and local numbers. Port existing numbers for $5 a month.
DocuSign is an online electronic signature service. It is integrated with Box.net, so users can send files to be e-signed with DocuSign from within the Box.net environment.
Code It allows users to write code without leaving their Firefox OS phone. The aplication uses the HackerEarth API to help with enabling coding capabilities.

Want to know how to build an anonymous chat service like ChatRoulette? Check this tutorial on how to build such an app! The tutorial is organised in the form of a rage comic, which conveys emotions in a universally understood manner. :-)
Interactive bike routing by intersection for the city of Chicago.
